name: Ezra
bio: Archetype: Delayed Buff, Moxie/Eureka Generation. ⌽ Deals some Genesis DMG; effective against high-DEF enemies. ⌽ Plant mushrooms on skill use, granting buffs when fully grown (after 3 turns). ⌽ Using Ult accumulates [Eureka] and gives Moxie & [Eureka] to team. ⌽ Consumes [Eureka] to gain Moxie or speed up mushroom growth. ⌽ Synergy: AP-Generous and Crit-oriented units (Regulus, Tooth Fairy, etc.)
